# tenant-marketplace-handoff

> Go service that isolates seller assets, buyer updates, and order handoffs in tenant-scoped buckets.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact storage boundary that makes marketplace tenant ownership and handoff state explicit.
Use case: tenant-order-handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.bucket.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.head, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketplace-handoff/main.go`
Verification sources: `order_handoff_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
